company.name: Wise
company.shortDescription: Wise is a financial technology company that offers low-cost, fast international money transfers and multi-currency accounts.
company.description:
Wise provides a core money transfer product, along with a borderless account for its audience of ex-pats, freelancers, and travelers, which holds over £2 billion in current deposits. 

The company features like automated identification verification, online and in-app technical assistance, and estimations of when money transfers will arrive, products and services that meet the needs of clients.

Wise was established in 2011 by Kristo Kaarmann and Taavet Hinrikus in London, England.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Post IPO Debt round raised $346,919,872, or 20.83% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.
caveats: Crunchbase reports 13 rounds but provides 10 detailed rows.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $958,000,000 to $5,000,000,000, a 5.22x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 79 (-10 over 90 days) and market heat at 47 (-32).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
